card: One failure ladder for one-shot and warm turns; warm sessions degrade in place
guard_cases: warm_turn_model_not_found_is_returned_not_rotated (Fatal never rotates; green before by design)
deviations_from_card: step takes Failure by value plus the candidate label (returns Rotate{cool,reason}) instead of &Failure, so Stop can carry the EngineError without cloning. Warm exhaustion without an API key now returns Unavailable naming every account and sets FleetMode::Down (was EngineError::RateLimited from the last account); both are fleet-class for the brain. Case 3 reaches 'all accounts rate-limited' after an earlier answered turn by letting the idle reaper end the process and rewriting the fake accounts' fake.json; case 4 warms the process with one turn before rewriting (the fake reads its config at start-up). The API stub is a loopback tokio TcpListener (127.0.0.1:0), no external network. The alt-CLI rung keeps its old policy (any failure moves on) and the warm path does not reach alt CLIs (they are one-shot, not conversational). Mirror capped at 200 turns (MIRROR_MAX_TURNS), also applied to ApiSession history.
notes: Coupled files beyond the write set: none (fixtures were listed in new_files). Brain's cold fallback (brain lib.rs:657-668) untouched, as the card says; it now runs only when the warm ladder truly exhausts. Fake-CLI suite ran 5x green (timing-sensitive idle reaper case stable). Sibling sim files were dirty in the tree during the gates; workspace test still green. Two commits: test (4 red asserts + guard compile at HEAD) then feat.
